'''Velken Tezeri''' was a former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who spent time working for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] as a guard and supplier of munitions, where he worked with [[Hermi Odle/Legends|Hermi Odle]].<ref name="RotJ" />

Like many other henchmen of Jabba the Hutt, Tezeri was also plotting to kill his master. He planned to do so using remotely controlled [[seeker]]s set to trap the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] upon his return from the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]], but his plans were cut short, as he was knocked off a [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|Bantha-II cargo skiff]] by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and became the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc's]] first victim during the skirmish resulting from Skywalker's execution escape.<ref name="RotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Velken Tezeri was played by an uncredited performer in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]].<ref name="RotJ" />
